bushwick: Warm practical apartment light; ordinary daylight and neighborhood spill. Preserve bright sitcom readability rather than noir contrast.
dti: Flat fluorescent institutional light with toner-gray surfaces, stale-office fatigue, and clear readable faces.
silas: Over-lit LED-clean productivity aesthetic; sterile rather than futuristic.
museum: White clinical conservation lighting; dehumidified and invasive.
transitAndCivic: Harsh public lighting, scratched reflective surfaces, practical fixtures, no glamorization.
exteriorNYC: Natural contemporary daylight/night practicals appropriate to location; keep the city recognizable and ordinary.
hearing: Municipal institutional lighting; restrained, clear, consequential, not courtroom melodrama.
